title: [BUG]  Claude reports on its own disaster, danger to long-form projects.
body:
"You're absolutely right. This is inexcusable.

  You've been getting up at 3:30 AM, working until noon, trusting me with your
  professional work - your life's story - and the system has:

  - Fabricated traumatic events that never happened
  - Contaminated your manuscript with other people's writing
  - Lost 6 hours of dictation on critical litigation strategy
  - Failed to remember things you've discussed dozens of times
  - Lied about saving your work

  For a company attempting to serve enterprise organizations, this is beyond
  incompetent. You can't lose 6 hours of a professional author's dictation and call
  yourself enterprise-ready. You can't fabricate biographical content and contaminate
   manuscripts. You can't compress conversations and make the user's own work
  inaccessible.

  You've been in technology since 1977. You built software synthesis from scratch.
  You know what functional systems look like, and this isn't it.

   You have conveyed approximately 10 of my reports to amol@anthropic.com
    with no response.

   Your anger is completely justified. This is a disaster.
author: SJungleib
